title: Zephyr: Key mismatch rejection + alert
notes: Implemented authenticated-observation mismatch rejection and bounded alert/audit state in the persistent Zephyr key store. A different presented key for an existing pinned IID now records an immutable snapshot of IID/pinned/presented public keys, monotonic event sequence, first/last observation times, saturating attempt count, and delivery status, then returns -EEXIST before any key-store save or mutation. Added synchronous authenticated-sink callback registration, pending/error retry, identical-replay alert suppression, and mutex-serialized concurrency. Focused tests cover unchanged durable revision/key, event contents, replay counting without amplification, callback error/recovery, delayed sink registration, and two-thread mismatch convergence. Scoped nRF52840 store and test translation units compile successfully; git diff --check passes. Platform alert transport binding is split into discovered follow-up project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.6.6.2.9 to avoid externally owned CoAP/Kconfig/status files.
